category.title: Category
category.description: Exactly one of: Shipment Delay, Refill Support, Insurance Support, General Program Support, Possible Adverse Event.

description.title: Description
description.description: Facts as shown in the approved proposal. No medical advice.

dispenseNumber.title: Dispense Number
dispenseNumber.description: Optional shipment number such as DSP-0016. Leave empty if not about a shipment.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Short plain subject without a category tag, as shown in the approved proposal.

userConfirmed.title: User Confirmed
userConfirmed.description: True only if the user's latest message explicitly approves creating this exact case. Otherwise false.
